prompt: Take a look at our email worker below. It drains a backlog of about 50,000 queued "send email" jobs, and monitoring shows the process idling around 5% CPU the whole time while jobs trickle out roughly one per second. A teammate wants to just crank `concurrency` up to 100 and call it a day. Walk me through what's actually going on here, what value you'd set `concurrency` to instead, and how you'd verify you picked the right number rather than guessing.
